Rows.Text: (Read-Only) The URN of the carousel content
The array of cards in the carousel

The web page that can be associated with the content and is opened when the member clicks on the content. For example, if the content is an image and the landing page is a web page then clicking on the image will take the member to the web page. If empty, then there's no landing page associated with the content.
The media contained in the card. Only supports images.
The alternative text for the media. None if empty. Must be less than 4,086 characters in length.
The title for media. None if empty. Must be less than 400 characters in length.

Blocks.Text: Carousel posts must be sponsored and are not intended to be a regular post.

http


curl
POST https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts
A successful response returns a 201 Created HTTP status code and the ID in the x-restli-id response header.
Retrieve carousel content associated with a Post by performing a GET operation to the Posts API on a post that was created with carousel content. Example post ID: urn:li:ugcPost:6914373086788128769

http


curl
GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts/{postId}

curl --location --request GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts/urn:li:ugcPost:6914373086788128769' \
--header 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
Fetch multiple posts with carousel content by providing multiple post IDs.

http


curl
GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts?ids=List({encoded postId},{encoded postId})

curl --location --request GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts?ids=List(urn%3Ali%3AugcPost%3A6914373086788128769,urn%3Ali%3AugcPost%3A6914374851449270272)' \
--header 'X-RestLi-Method: batch_get' \
--header 'X-Restli-Protocol-version: 2.0.0' \
--header 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}'
